title: Executive Overview & 3D Mine View

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "org.stepnoe:Stockpile_01" and r._field == "value_weight_properties_value")
  |> group(columns: ["thingId", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "weight")
